_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows a ranked book list as cards with covers, difficulty, and literary regard scores

author_gender.description: Only books by women, or only books by men

country.description: The authors' country, e.g. "Japan", "United States", "Nigeria". These have list pages: Italy, Russia, France, Japan, the United States, Britain, Ireland, Germany, Canada, Spain, Poland, India, China, Australia, Norway, Sweden, Nigeria, Austria, South Africa. Another country is ranked from the books the catalog holds by its authors.

difficulty.description: A difficulty band ("easy" under 45 of 100, "moderate" 45 to 64, "challenging" 65 and over), still ranked by literary regard; or "hardest" for the hardest books with high literary regard, ranked by difficulty

genre.description: A genre: literary-fiction, historical-fiction, romance, fantasy, science-fiction, mystery-crime, thriller, horror, satire-humor, coming-of-age, short-fiction, war-fiction, poetry, drama, memoir, biography, essays, philosophy, history, science, politics-society, psychology-self, religion, childrens, young-adult, graphic-novels, lgbtq, nonfiction

language.description: The original language, e.g. "French". These have list pages: French, Spanish, Russian, German, Chinese, Italian, Japanese, Polish.

limit.description: How many books from the top of the list (default 10, max 100)

subject.description: A period, theme, region or movement, by name or slug, e.g. "death-mortality", "war-conflict", "victorian-19th-century-literature", "magical-realism", "african-literature". A word from the name is enough when it names one ("gothic"). An unknown subject returns the full list of subjects.

name: get_top_books

books.description: The top of the list, in rank order

id.description: Work UUID, for book_id arguments of other tools

year.description: Publication year, when the catalog's year can be the author's own

filters_applied.description: Each filter as it was matched, e.g. country: Japan; only set filters appear

list.description: The list the books come from

ranked_by.description: What the order is based on, in a sentence or two

ranking.description: "curated" for the hand-ranked canon, "computed" for a ranking from scores

title.description: The list page's heading, with the whole list's count

total.description: Books on the whole list, up to 100

url.description: The list's page on readingrate.com; null for a country or language that has no page

note.description: Present when the list is short, empty, or has no page

title: Top-ranked books
